method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, truth-clause and tag inspection, formula/token comparison and reverse paraphrase with checked native terminology; not independent or human review.
scope: Propositional valuations, their inductive extension to formulas, truth tables, local determination, satisfaction and its equivalence with truth-value evaluation.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A valuation maps each propositional variable to one of the two truth values. Its evaluation extension maps every formula to a truth value: constants have their fixed values, variables inherit the valuation, and negation, conjunction, disjunction, conditional and biconditional receive exactly the displayed recursive values.
samples.checks: Every domain, codomain, tag branch, equality, true/false case, and and/or condition in the evaluation definition is preserved exactly.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The five tables display the same truth functions. A proposed ternary connective returns B's value when A is true and C's value when A is false, and the exercise asks for its truth table.
samples.checks: All table rows are unchanged, as are the ternary argument order and its two selector cases.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If two valuations agree on every propositional variable occurring in A, their induced evaluations agree on A. The proof is by induction on A.
samples.checks: The theorem's locality remains restricted to variables occurring in the fixed formula A, and the conclusion compares the two induced values of that same A.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Satisfaction by a valuation is recursively defined: false is never satisfied, true always is, a variable is satisfied exactly when assigned true, and the five connective cases follow their classical conditions. A valuation satisfies a set Gamma exactly when it satisfies every member.
samples.checks: Positive and negative satisfaction notation, every iff direction, both-inclusive disjunctions, the biconditional both/neither split, and universal set scope are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A valuation satisfies A exactly when A evaluates to true; the proposition is proved by induction on A and is also assigned as an exercise.
samples.checks: The equivalence, true value, induction variable and cross-reference remain exact.

limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
सत्य-मूल्यांकन, मूल्यन फलन and स्थानिक निर्धारण remain explicitly prioritized for specialist review.
